balancedBooks: The books balance: debits equal credits.
booksReady: The chart of accounts and posting rules are ready.
cashFlowHint: Cash, bank, mobile money and card accounts: what you started with, what moved them, and what you ended with.
chooseAccountHint: Choose an account above to see every line posted to it, with a running balance.
dateOrder: The start date must not be after the end date.
exportHint: The journal lines of the dates above, as a file for your accountant's software. Try a small file first.

exportLayouts.quickbooksHint: Journal import layout for QuickBooks Online.

name: Name
netPayableHint: VAT charged less VAT paid; a negative figure is owed back to you.
notBalanced: These figures do not balance. Ask your accountant to run the books check.
notReconciled: The movements do not add up to the closing balance. Ask your accountant to run the books check.
nothingPostedHint: Try a wider date range, or include accounts with a zero balance.
unclosedProfit: Profit not yet closed into equity

problems.fewLines: Add at least two lines with an account and an amount.
problems.noAccount: A line has an amount but no account.
problems.bothSides: A line has both a debit and a credit. Use one or the other.
problems.noAmount: A line has an account but no amount.

reports.title: Financial reports
reports.hint: Reports come straight from the books and can be run for any past date.
reports.notFoundHint: The address names a report that is not here. Pick one from the list.

accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.hint: Every account the books use. Control accounts are kept by sales, stock and purchases, not by hand.
accounts.emptyHint: Set up the books to create a starter chart of accounts and posting rules, then edit them to suit your business.
accounts.controlHint: Control accounts are kept by their sub-ledgers (stock, customers, suppliers). They cannot be posted to by hand or switched off.
accounts.subtypeHint: Optional, for example cash or receivable.
accounts.parentHint: Optional. Shows this account indented under another of the same type.
accounts.inUseHint: Switch off to stop using the account. Past entries stay.
accounts.mappingHint: What your accountant's software calls this account. Used in the journal export.

journal.title: Journal
journal.hint: Every entry in the books, from sales, stock, expenses and by hand. Entries are never edited; mistakes are reversed.
journal.emptyHint: Entries appear when you sell, move stock, record expenses or post a manual journal.
journal.noManualHint: Use a manual journal for adjustments that no sale, stock movement or expense covers.

entry.correctInSource: This entry came from another document (a sale, a stock movement or an expense). To correct it, correct that document: a return, an adjustment or a reversal.
entry.reverseHint: This posts a mirror entry that cancels this one. It can be done once, and the reversal itself cannot be reversed.

manual.newHint: Debits must equal credits before you can save.
manual.linesHint: Each line is either a debit or a credit. Control accounts are not listed.
manual.submitAsk: Submit this journal? It posts to the books at once, or goes to an approver if an approval rule applies to its size.
manual.draftHint: This is a draft. It changes nothing in the books until it is submitted.
manual.pendingHint: Waiting for an approver. It posts when approved.
manual.rejectedHint: An approver rejected this journal. Nothing was posted.

setup.title: Periods and posting rules
setup.hint: Close months when they are done, and control which account each kind of document uses.

periods.title: Periods
periods.emptyHint: A month appears here when something is first posted in it.
periods.openHint: Creates the monthly period that contains this date.
periods.ready: Everything is in order: no journals are waiting for approval and the stock ledger agrees with the books.
periods.blocked: This period cannot be closed yet:

ask.open: Reopen {{period}}? Anyone with posting rights can post into it again.
ask.soft_closed: Close {{period}}? Only people allowed to close periods can post manual journals into it, and documents follow your late posting setting.
ask.locked: Lock {{period}}? Nothing can be posted into it again and it can never be reopened.

rules.title: Posting rules
rules.hint: Posting rules say which account each line of a sale, stock movement or other document goes to. A rule with conditions beats a general one. Changes apply to documents posted from now on.
rules.emptyHint: Set up the books on the chart of accounts page to create the default rules.
rules.documentHint: The kind of document, as the system names it.
rules.whenHint: Optional conditions that must match, for example movement type = write_off.
rules.changeHint: Only the account can be changed. To change anything else, add a new rule and delete this one.
rules.deleteAsk: Delete this posting rule? Documents that need it will fail to post until another rule covers them.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.hint: Costs paid at once from cash, bank, mobile money or card. Costs bought on credit go through supplier bills.
expenses.emptyHint: Record fuel, rent, repairs and other costs as they are paid.
expenses.categoryHint: The expense account this cost belongs to.
expenses.taxHint: The tax part of the amount, if any.
expenses.receiptHint: The receipt number or file name. The file itself is not stored yet.
expenses.submitAsk: Submit this expense of {{amount}}? It posts to the books at once, or goes to an approver if an approval rule applies to its size.
expenses.draftHint: This is a draft. It changes nothing in the books until it is submitted.
expenses.pendingHint: Waiting for an approver. It posts when approved.
expenses.rejectedHint: An approver rejected this expense. Nothing was posted.
expenses.reverseHint: This posts a mirror entry that cancels the expense in the books.

bank.title: Bank reconciliation
bank.hint: Check your bank, mobile money or card account against its statement, until the difference is zero.
bank.startHint: Enter the date and closing balance printed on the statement. You will then tick the books' lines that appear on it.
bank.accountHint: A bank, mobile money or card account.
bank.balanceHint: Use a minus sign if the account is overdrawn.
bank.emptyHint: Start one when you receive a statement.
bank.outstandingHint: Deposits in transit, cheques not yet presented
bank.workHint: Tick the lines that appear on your statement and mark them cleared. Or load the statement to match lines automatically.
bank.finalHint: Completed {{date}}. A completed reconciliation is final.
bank.waiting: In the books, not yet on the statement ({{count}})
bank.completeAsk: Complete this reconciliation? It is final: its lines will not be cleared again.
bank.discardAsk: Throw away this reconciliation and its ticks? Nothing in the books changes.
bank.chargesHint: Bank charges that are on the statement but not in the books: record them first as an expense or manual journal.
bank.importHint: Load the statement's lines as CSV (date, reference, description, amount; money in is positive, money out is negative). Matches are found by amount, then reference, then nearest date.
bank.noMatches: No statement line matched a line in the books.
bank.unmatchedHint: Record these (for example bank charges) before completing.
